# Registered offending peaks among young men in every population group (fixture)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

Registered offending rises steeply during adolescence, peaks in the early twenties and
declines thereafter. The shape of the curve is remarkably stable across countries,
periods and population groups. Because groups differ in their age composition, any raw
comparison between groups mixes an effect of age structure into the comparison. Where
one group is on average younger and more often male than another, a higher raw rate is
expected regardless of any other difference between the groups.
